text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak to participate today in the Davos forum. He will take part in the session on the Middle East and Africa. Egypt's participation in the meeting is seen as a push to the results of the economic conference held in Cairo in November.
- World Bank delegation to visit Egypt to discuss support for the country's southern agricultural projects.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton and Mubarak will meet in Washington on March 10 in a summit to focus on achieving peace on the Lebanese, Syrian and Palestinian tracks.
- Mubarak starts immediate talks with world leaders on his arrival in Davos. He will also hold talks in Paris with the French President Jacques Chirac.
- Seventy-seven more suspects held for devil worship.
- Mubarak and the Kazakh president discuss bilateral cooperation on the sidelines of the Davos meeting. Mubarak will announce to the forum Egypt's view of regional cooperation.
